summary: The `no_valid_comparison` closure stands. All 51 source files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 hashes, and all six proposed computations reproduced. None of the 17 author DESeq2 comparisons pairs female PND37 with PND22. The corrected proposal identifies a mislabeled volcano plot, clarifies that the larger DESeq2 tables retain only complete rows, and records that the companion qPCR study reports an aggregate count for the requested age pair. [Author DESeq2 deposit](https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.25517503) · [Companion qPCR study](https://doi.org/10.1093/hmg/ddx246)
openIssues: Gene-level effect, raw P-value and FDR agreement remain unassessed for female whole hypothalamus at PND37 versus PND22.
